title: talon.audit.v1 — Audit Record
description: ADR 0041 §6 — canonical NDJSON audit record shape emitted by Talon at every request/response cycle. Consumed by audit-replay --validate-schema (Phase 8.c.3), compliance-evidence framework controls (Phase 8.d), and the WORM archive replay tooling. Forward-compatible per the 7-year retention contract: every field is optional EXCEPT `ts` so an older binary's recorded events stay parseable. Strict-mode validation surfaces field-type drift early.

ts.description: Event timestamp in RFC 3339 with optional nano precision. Required so chronological ordering is always derivable.

seq.description: Hash-chain sequence number per ADR 0041 §6.b. Per-pod-monotonic.

prev_hash.description: Hash-chain PrevHash — hex of the prior record's Hash. Empty for the first record in a chain. Validated by audit-replay --reconstruct-session for chain integrity.

hash.description: Hash-chain Hash — hex sha256 of (PrevHash || canonical record). Empty before chain.Stamp middleware was wired (forward compat).

event.description: Event family name — used by --ztna-decision-stats + --reconstruct-session transition mapping. Recognized values are listed in cmd/audit-replay/session.go:transitionFor.

sub.description: Falcon-ID OIDC subject (opaque UUID). Used as the primary user identity correlator.

email.description: Falcon-ID-resolved email at the time of the event. May trail behind iam_users.email if user changed email; that's intentional (the audit log records what Talon SAW).

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope of the event. opaque UUID.

route.description: TalonRoute host that handled the request (e.g. internal.example.com).

path.description: Upstream request path. Capped at a generous 4KB to defend the WORM archive against unbounded growth from pathological query strings.

reason.description: Reason code or short string explaining the decision. For deny: machine-stable code (e.g. ztna: tier=TIER_BYOD route requires TIER_CORP). For allow/passthrough: optional context (rate-limited / cached / etc.).

src_ip.description: Source IP that initiated the request. v4 or v6 textual representation.

permission.description: SpiceDB permission that was checked for this request (talon-conf editor/viewer/admin per TalonRoute spec).

decision_id.description: Stable identifier for THIS particular enforcement decision (joins to OPA decision log + Talon's own decision cache).

sso_chain_id.description: Chain identifier linking ALL records emitted during one SSO authentication ceremony (login + MFA + grant). Used for end-to-end session reconstruction.

talon_version.description: Talon binary semver tag emitting the record. Per ADR 0001 §3 record-emitter version is essential for replay-tool compatibility across the 7-year retention window.
